name: Pixel Canary
short: Callstack's Apex coding model (revealed from stealth 'Pixel Canary', 262K, image in): 28/31 Next.js tasks baseline, 30/31 with docs, 87.8% on React Native evals.
pricingNote: $0.50/M in, $0.20 cached, $3.00/M out (GA) - the 'free while stealth' claim is unverified
freeTierNote: Free for a limited time while in stealth (Vercel AI Gateway); no ZDR, prompts may be used for training
standout: The React specialist: a domain post-train that beats frontier models on its own framework evals at 1/13th the cost.
tradeoff: Two framework evals are the entire evidence base - no SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench or LiveCodeBench row exists, and the model is closed.
